verdict.rationale: Zapier's agents.zapier.com/agents page and Copilot indicate you can create AI agents that connect to business data and perform tasks across thousands of apps, implying LLM+tool-use steps inside workflows, but the evidence never specifies model choice (e.g., selecting GPT vs Claude) or granular tool-use configuration within a Zap step. missing for 10: explicit documentation of selectable LLM/model options inside a workflow step, detailed tool-use/function-calling configuration, and independent hands-on confirmation of the AI-agent-in-workflow experience.
